summary: Describes a class of BGP configurations with more than one stable outcome, where the state actually reached may be unintended and equally stable. Such configurations are called BGP Wedgies. It challenges the common belief that BGP always produces forwarding paths in a deterministic way. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Imagine a ball that can settle in two different dips. Sometimes the internet routes settle in the wrong dip and stay stuck there, even though the right one is also stable.
